rows.label: Enigma Sense
rows.note: Drifter upgrade from Acrithis, Dormizone only

conditions: The Archarbor only appears in The Duviri Experience.

groups.activity: solve the Archarbor puzzle every time it's up; gather Eevani

rows.label: Cinta piece (any)
rows.note: main Blueprint, Grip, Lower Limb, Upper Limb or String

conditions: The Archarbor exists only during the Joy, Envy and Sorrow spirals, not Anger or Fear.
Open it by rotating the three Dominus Thrax busts at the island's edges to face the center, hacking security at the southwest point, then pressing the button inside the cave.
A squad of 2+ also unlocks 6% multiplayer Enigmas elsewhere in Duviri; solo caps you at 4% single-player puzzles plus the Archarbor.
bonuses: Solving the Archarbor also pays 5 Enigma Gyrum each time.

disclosures.title: drop odds
disclosures.body: Each solve has a chance of one Cinta piece: Archarbor and multiplayer Enigmas 30%, single-player Enigmas 20%. The pieces are evenly weighted, so 6% per piece, or 4% on a single-player Enigma.

disclosures.title: finding puzzles
disclosures.body: Enigma Sense waypoints Enigmas within 150m; without it, listen for the Paragrimm owl's distinct sound.
